rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MAGNA CARTA OF WORKERS IN THE INFORMAL SECTOR, INSTITUTIONALIZING MECHANISMS FOR IMPLEMENTATION THEREOF AND AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NOS. 7160 AND 8282
rows.abstract:
Provides that workers engaged in an economic activity shall belong to an informal sector: those who are operating, employed, or working either as a micro-entrepreneur or is self-employed like vendors, small farmers, marginalized fisherfolks, home-based workers, and small transport;  own-account or those who are self-employed such as on-call domestic and service workers, barbers/manicurists/pedicurists, drivers, barkers/fare collectors/dispatchers, welders/mechanics, non-corporate construction workers, appliance technicians, scavengers.
Proposes to extend protection to these workers, accord them opportunities and their rights, through providing standardized social security measures, registration system, LGU one-stop-shop, Informal Sector Local Development Office, legitimate organizations, workplace security, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2021-08-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE DUTY TO RENDER ASSISTANCE AT SEA IN ACCORDANCE WITH RELEVANT INTERNATIONAL CONVENTIONS TO WHICH THE PHILIPPINES IS A STATE PARTY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
“ Good Samaritan at Sea Law ”
Proposes to hold the vessel´s captain, crew, and passengers liable for refusing or failing to assist persons in distress at sea; and penalizes violators of this Act with a fine depending on the size of the vessel or ship.
Provides that under specific circumstances, when a ship is unable to respond to a distress alert, the ship captain has to document the reason for his failure to render assistance and immediately inform the search and rescue service or the Philippine Coast Guard.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2021-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10642 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "PHILIPPINE LEMON LAW" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the technical hardships and non-warranted troubles experienced by motor vehicle buyers in claiming and invoking their rights under the Philippine Lemon Law.
Defines  CRITICAL NONCONFORMITY ISSUE TO ANY DEFECT WHICH COULD AFFECT THE CONTROL OR DIRECTIONAL STABILITY OF THE VEHICLE, OR CAUSE INJURY TO THE PEOPLE INSIDE OR OUTSIDE THE VEHICLE, and provides condition when a replacement with a brand new motor vehicle is necessary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2021-08-03
